name: The Hidden Acquisitions Index
description: The Hidden Acquisitions Index is an open, source-checked dataset of transactions in which large companies gained an AI company's people, technology or influence without buying the company: licence and team hires, team hires, minority stakes with control rights, investments tied to compute commitments, and investments with commercial partnerships. Version 1.1.0 records 109 deals (36 core, 63 related, 10 on hold) announced between 23 January 2023 and 30 October 2026, involving 33 buyers, with 1,700 sources (1,460 official records and 240 major-newsroom reports). Every coded fact is linked to a source with an exact quote of at most 20 words; 99.9% of quotes were confirmed word for word by at least one check between 15 and 18 November 2026 (live page, archived copy, rendered page or a separate second check), and the check result is recorded for every source. It also records 82 regulator events, 62 disclosed amounts kept as separate components (never summed), outcomes at 6, 12 and 24 months, and 168 candidates excluded with their reasons.

field.name: announce_date
field.description: First public announcement (YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM where only month known)

field.name: target_focus
field.description: What the target does, from sources

field.name: equity_stake_pct
field.description: Buyer shareholding after the deal, percent

field.name: disclosed_value_usd
field.description: Disclosed consideration in USD; never estimated

field.name: value_note
field.description: Scope of the value: what it covers

field.name: value_source_grade
field.description: Grade of the best source for the value

field.name: staff_moved
field.description: Number or description of staff who moved

field.name: target_status_after
field.description: continued / pivoted / product discontinued / wound down / bankruptcy / sold

field.name: regulatory_review
field.description: Highest level of regulator review known

field.name: buyer_tier
field.description: mega-cap over $100bn / other listed / AI lab

field.name: index_tier
field.description: core (strict control rule), extended (investment plus commercial tie-in, or AI infrastructure), hold (evidence below threshold)

field.name: target_layer
field.description: Foundation models, applied AI and agents, infrastructure, etc.

field.name: company_rationale
field.description: Reason given by the companies, quoted or closely paraphrased

field.name: threshold_jurisdiction
field.description: Target operating-country proxy for merger thresholds (not a finding that a filing was required)

field.name: voting_board_seat
field.description: Buyer holds a voting board seat (yes/no/not disclosed)

field.name: exclusivity
field.description: Commercial exclusivity linked to the deal

field.name: licence_exclusive_confirmed
field.description: Exclusivity stated in an official source

field.name: cloud_compute_spending_commitment
field.description: Target compute spend commitment tied to stake

field.name: remainder_6m
field.description: Remainder status about 6 months after announcement

field.name: tier_reason
field.description: Why the record sits in its tier

field.name: dma_notification_date
field.description: Date of EU DMA Article 14 notification

field.name: archive_note
field.description: Why a source has no archived copy (for example, the site blocks archiving). Empty when an archived copy exists.

field.name: quote_status
field.description: Best result across all checks: exact if any method found the quote word for word.

field.name: automated_check_result
field.description: Result of the deterministic checker (verify_sources.py), which fetches the page or archived copy and looks for the quote.

field.name: rendered_check_result
field.description: Result of a check on the page as rendered in a browser, used where the page needs JavaScript (e.g. the EU DMA register).

field.name: second_check_by
field.description: Who or what made the separate second check of the quote, value and date.

field.name: second_check_at_utc
field.description: When the second check was made.

field.name: research_round
field.description: Research round in which the source was added (blank = before round 6).
